messages:
Aisha (partnerships): Quick sync — we need final signoff and asset handoff for the joint catalog launch next month. Key asks: press embargo timing, partner quotes, landing page hero copy, marketplace listing screenshots, and lead-gen form + GA. Tagging folks: @Tom, @Priya, @Diego, @Maya, @Olga
Tom (marketing): Got it. Can PR embargo be 2 days before public? That gives us time to queue blog + socials. :thinking_face:
Priya (PR): 2 days is fine if legal approves partner quotes by EOD Wed. Need final partner logos + one-liner from their comms lead.
Aisha (partnerships): I emailed partners this morning. Expect logos + quote by Tue EOD for GCP and Azure; AWS might be slower.
Diego (design): I'll start hero comps today. Need final logo files (SVG, 2x PNG) and brand color from partner. If we don't have, I'll mock placeholders.
Maya (legal): I'll review partner quote language. Send drafts here. Note: partners often want approval on quote edits — allocate ~24h for back-and-forth.
Luca (product): Landing page tech note — we need to include model variants, latency/cost callouts, and a CTA to "Try on Hosted API" + "Request Dedicated". Also update docs link to dedicated pricing.
Olga (eng-infra): Marketplace listing screenshots — I can provision a demo account and take screenshots Wed morning. Need final UI strings to avoid last-minute text diffs.
Aisha (partnerships): Action items + tentative timeline:

- Tue AM: partners deliver assets (logos, quotes)
- Tue PM: design comps + marketing draft
- Wed AM: legal signoff
- Wed PM: QA screenshots + blog finalization
- Thu AM: embargoed press send
- Thu noon: go-live

Priya (PR): Can we push embargo to Wed PM to align with partner availability? Prefer same-day send as partner approvals.
Aisha (partnerships): Ok flexible — update timeline block:

```
Tue AM: assets in
Tue PM: design + marketing draft
Wed AM: legal review
Wed PM: final partner approval -> embargo send
Thu noon: publish
```

Tom (marketing): I'll prepare blog skeleton and social calendar. Need a 120-150 word partner quote and a 30-40 word product highlight for the hero.
Diego (design): Uploading initial hero v1 to Figma in a bit. @Tom please flag copy changes there.
Maya (legal): Also confirm we have partner logo usage rights. If not, need written permission — partners sometimes attach an email granting usage.
Aisha (partnerships): Partners confirmed logo rights for GCP & Azure, AWS pending approval.
Olga (eng-infra): Quick note — marketplace listing requires a 1:1 screenshot at 1440x900 and a 300x250 thumbnail. I'll capture both.
Luca (product): For accuracy, include model names + default sequence lengths. I can paste exact specs later.
Priya (PR): Drafting press release now. Will share a Google Doc link when ready. Please add partner PR contacts.
Tom (marketing): I'll sync paid channels with campaign start 48h after publish. Means we need final UTM links Thu morning.
Aisha (partnerships): Who owns tracking + lead-gen form? @Tom or @Luca?
Luca (product): We'll wire the form to our internal webhook. Tom to provide UTM params; I'll add to the demo link.
Tom (marketing): Sending UTM params in #marketing in 30m.
Diego (design): Uploaded figma link: https://www.figma.com/file/abc123/partner-launch — comps in 'hero/v1' frame.
Aisha (partnerships): Thanks. Final checklist before embargo:
- [ ] Logos & quotes collected
- [ ] Legal approval
- [ ] Hero + screenshots
- [ ] Blog + press draft
- [ ] Marketplace listing filled
- [ ] Tracking UTMs + form wiring

Can people add ✅ when done.
Priya (PR): ✅ draft press release created (in doc)
Tom (marketing): ✅ UTMs posted in #marketing
Diego (design): ✅ hero v1 uploaded
Maya (legal): I'll mark ✅ when I finish review Wed AM
Olga (eng-infra): Will post ✅ after screenshots Wed PM
Aisha (partnerships): Appreciate it. Small ask for partner briefing call — 30m on Tue 10am PT to confirm quotes & logos. Can everyone make it? If invite exists I'll send calendar.
Luca (product): I can make Tue 10am PT.
Priya (PR): I can make it.
Tom (marketing): Same.
Diego (design): On my calendar.
Maya (legal): I'll try to join; allocate someone from legal if I can't.
Olga (eng-infra): I'll skip but will watch assets channel.
LaunchBot: Reminder scheduled: Tue 10:00 PT — Partner assets check-in
Aisha (partnerships): Thanks all. I'll send invite and paste the partner email thread in #partnerships-assets. Quick note: partner wants joint quote to mention 'Redwood Inference's dedicated runtime' — legal please watch phrasing.
Priya (PR): Noted. I'll craft neutral phrasing: '...worked with Redwood Inference to integrate...' to avoid technical claims.
Tom (marketing): Small creative idea — feature a short customer quote about latency improvement. Anyone with numbers? @Olga or @Luca?
Luca (product): We have internal bench: median p95 latency down 18% on Dedicated for 2k token seq. Can use that as 'internal benchmark' if needed with clarity.
Maya (legal): If using numbers, mark them as 'internal benchmarks' and run by partners before publish.
Aisha (partnerships): Great — we'll keep numbers labeled. I'll collect partner approval on that in the Tue call.
Priya (PR): Sharing doc now: https://docs.google.com/document/d/PR-DRAFT
Aisha (partnerships): End of thread — will update after Tue call. Thanks everyone! :rocket:
